name: PoMade
description: The repository presentation companion for coding agents. Keep your README, real media, GitHub About, and topics in step with the code you ship.
installCommand:
git clone https://github.com/Gurtejhundal/PoMade.git
cd PoMade
npm ci
npm run build
npm link
runCommand:
# Run inside the repository you want to polish
pomade init --preset signature --approved
pomade diff
pomade apply --approved

features.title: Three README styles
features.description: Simple for a clear first run, Signature for a distinct identity, and Motion for an animated cover and real demo media.

features.title: Polish after a push
features.description: A GitHub Action maintains marked README sections and cover assets on pushes to main. Text outside managed sections stays yours.

features.title: The whole front door
features.description: Configure a concise About, homepage, and curated topics. Sync metadata with an administration-scoped token while preserving existing topics.

features.title: A coding-agent companion
features.description: The bundled skill includes presentation in requested commit and push workflows. A Claude Code plugin manifest is included.

features.title: Preview before writing
features.description: Review a saved plan with target hashes, then apply that exact plan. Stale targets, escaping paths, and malformed markers are rejected.
